slug: 2026-04-28 Mozambique taps Ethiopia's digital ID expertise in DPI partnership

facts.fact: Ethiopia's National ID Program and its business arm FaydaVerse signed a three-year digital identity and DPI memorandum of understanding with Mozambique's Digital Transformation and Innovation Agency in Addis Ababa on 27 April 2026. Biometric Update reports it.
Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed was recently named African Union Champion for AI and Digital Health; the article gives no exact date, so its published date (April 2026) is used.
facts.system: African Union Champion for AI and Digital Health

note: Joint working group and activities are planned, not stated as started.
